## **What is a WoW weekly reset**

What is a WoW weekly reset

**WoW Reset** is the weekly refresh of time‑gated content in WoW, like raid lockouts, M+ dungeons, weekly quests, world bosses, and Great Vault rewards. In retail as well as some Classic WoW versions, many activities are tied to WoW weekly reset, a.k.a reset timer.

WoW weekly reset happens every **Tuesday on US servers at 10 AM (EST)** and **Wednesday on EU servers at 5 AM (CET)** . The Midnight expansion also has a **WoW daily reset** , which occurs at **7 AM local server time** on **US servers** and at **3 AM local server time** on **EU servers** .

## **Why you need to know WoW weekly reset**

Why you need to know WoW weekly reset.
As we mentioned before, World of Warcraft weekly reset timer is tied to many activities which are crucial for your character progression.

* **Raid lockouts:** While you can run multiple raids with your guild, remember that loot is only obtainable once per week. This also affects your Great Vault rewards, which we’ll cover shortly. Lockouts apply even to Legacy raids, for example, your character can only farm Invincible once per week.
* **Weekly quests and world bosses:** The same principle applies here. Even older content, like MoP world bosses, follows the WoW weekly reset schedule.
* **Great Vault:** This is arguably the activity most tightly tied to the weekly reset. The Great Vault lets you earn high ilvl gear based on your weekly effort. You can also unlock Hero or Mythic tracks, which is why you’ll see a surge of players logging in right after the reset.
* **Dungeons:** Dungeons follow both WoW daily reset and weekly resets.
You can run a dungeon for loot up to 10 times in Normal difficulty per hour, 1 Heroic dungeon per day, and Mythic difficulty dungeon per week.

Note

Mythic difficulty dungeons have lockout, but M+ dungeons don’t.

## **WoW Classic weekly reset: How does it work**

WoW Classic weekly reset, How does it work.

WoW servers reset apply to all Classic Vanilla versions (Anniversary, SoD, and Hardcore alike). It has both universal Weekly Reset WoW time, as well as some individual reset timer. For example if you’ve completed Zul’Gurub on Monday you will be able to get loot next time only on Thursday.

Note

You may wonder how weekly reset works in MoP Classic. The answer is that it resets all weekly lockouts and activities with the global reset, just like other versions of WoW.

The full WoW reset schedule is:

|**Raid** |**Duration of lockout** |**Reset day** |

|Molten Core |7 days |Tues NA / Wed EU |
|Blackwing Lair |7 days |Tues NA / Wed EU |
|Ahn’Qiraj |7 days |Tues NA / Wed EU |
|Naxxramas |7 days |Tues NA / Wed EU |
|Onyxia’s Lair |5 days |Varies |
|Zul’Gurub |3 days |Varies |
|Ruins of Ahn’Qiraj |3 days |Varies |

## WoW Weekly reset FAQ

### **What is the WoW reset?**

The weekly reset is when time‑gated content in WoW refreshes. This includes raid lockouts, weekly quests, world bosses, and Great Vault rewards, allowing players to earn loot and progression again.

### **At what time does the WoW weekly reset happen?**

**US, Latin, Oceania servers:** Tuesday at 11 AM (EST)  
**EU servers:** Wednesday at 5 AM (CET)

### **When is the WoW daily reset time?**

WoW daily reset time US is 7 AM local server time, while EU servers reset at 3 AM local server time, refreshing daily quests and world quests in WoW.

### **Does the weekly reset affect all characters in World of Warcraft?**

Yes. Weekly reset timers apply account-wide.
This means every character on your account shares the same reset schedule for raid lockouts, weekly quest progress, and Great Vault rewards.

### **What content is affected by WoW daily reset?**

**What content is affected by WoW daily reset?** World of Warcraft daily reset typically refreshes:  
Daily quests and world quests  
Heroic dungeon lockouts  
Bountiful Delves  
Daily profession cooldowns  
Daily reputation activities  
Certain vendors and event activities

To ensure players have all the knowledge and details on _WoW's_ reset and what to do before it happens, here is when everything resets in _World of Warcraft_ on both a daily and weekly basis.

## When is the WoW Daily Reset?

_World of Warcraft's_ **daily reset happens at 8:00 AM Pacific (11:00 AM Eastern) for US** servers, while **in the EU, the daily reset happens at 08:00 AM CET** .
This is the lesser of the two resets the game has over a week. With this reset, players can expect daily quests, Heroic dungeon loot lockouts, and several other aspects to reset, allowing players to complete them again.

With the release of _Dragonflight_ , a good chunk of [daily quests moved to a bi-weekly](https://gamerant.com/wow-dragonflight-daily-quests-bi-weekly/) reset, making it easier for players to complete more quests with less pressure.

## When is the WoW Weekly Reset?

_World of Warcraft_ has its weekly reset **every Tuesday at at 8:00 AM Pacific (11:00 AM Eastern) on US** servers, while **for the EU, the weekly reset occurs at 5:00 CET on Wednesday** . This is the more significant reset, which sees raid lockouts, world bosses, weekly quests, several world quests, and Mythic+ resets and starts a fresh week for players to undertake. This is also often when weekly maintenance occurs, and any fixes, balance changes, or tweaks to the game are usually made during this time.

[Skrumpcious-1024308](https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/u/Skrumpcious-1024308) (Skrumpcious) October 5, 2020, 2:33am 3
Raids that reset every 7 days will always reset on Tuesday morning at like 10 or whatever. So mc/bwl/aq40/naxx will always follow that. You can do the raid on Monday then again on Tuesday, but then you’ll have to wait until the following Tuesday to go back. So yes on your \#2 (except it’s Tuesday instead of Wednesday).

You can reset a raid ID if you haven’t killed any bosses. So you can clear the trash and reset to get the trash back. But the moment you kill a boss you are locked to that instance ID.

For ony (which has a 5 day reset) and zg/aq20 (3 day reset), they too reset on their own time table. So if zg resets Thursday then you can do zg on Wednesday and then again on Thursday after the reset. Then you’ll have to wait until Sunday to enter a fresh raid again.
